snippet.title: The Artisan of Glimmith - Official Lunar Lights DLC Trailer | DevGamm Awards 2026
snippet.description:
Illuminate your mind in Lunar Lights, the dazzling new expansion for The Artisan of Glimmith. Celebrate the vibrant "Glass Lights Festival" as you master 12+ new puzzle rules designed to surprise and delight artisans of all experience levels. Step into the glow and unravel the festival's mysteries. The new trailer for The Artisan of Glimmith also showcases what some critics are saying about the puzzle game. The Artisan of Glimmith is available now on PC (Steam and GOG), and the Lunar Lights expansion launches in December 2026.

#IGN #gaming
